title: NYC CMS 2024: weighted all-purpose linked journeys and observed travel time
universe: Personal travel by NYC resident adults18+ in address-based sampled households, including trips outside NYC. Excludes nonresidents/visitors, children, commercial/delivery travel, group quarters outside sampling frame; field-period estimates, not full-year or all street users.
main_mode_rule: Within each linked ID, highest valid supplied mode_type1..14 across stages. Guide hierarchy applies to individual rows; extending it to linked journeys is an analyst rule. Unknown995 retained in denominator. Do not multiply weights by party size.
duration_rule: Last-arrival minus first-departure timestamp; includes observed between-stage intervals. Synthetic access/egress timestamps copy neighboring stage boundaries, so their unmeasured time is absent. Survey timestamps include RSG departure-time imputation. These are recorded/reconstructed journey minutes, not fully measured door-to-door time. Sum-of-known-leg and complete-leg cases are separate sensitivity universes.
weight_rule: One trip_weight_citywide per reconstructed linked journey; baseline requires identical positive finite weights on every stage and complete original-anchor day.39 complete-day inconsistent-weight journeys omitted; original anchor, first-stage, maximum-stage alternatives provided.

guide_sections.3.3: Online/call-center home-based trip weights adjusted2x; other rates1x; use supplied weights.
guide_sections.4.6: Survey universe, citywide versus zonal weights, limitations.
guide_sections.4.7: Join keys, table weights, zero-trip days, transit unlinking and synthetic missing duration, main-mode hierarchy.

sequential_attrition.stage: Original-anchor day complete in both Trip and Day tables
Adult participant with NYC household record
Identical positive finite citywide weight on all legs

subway_indicator.definition: At least one public stage states code30 Subway in mode_1..mode_9 or mode_priority; overlaps main Transit. PATH/SIR/rail not counted as subway in this indicator.

missing_transit_time_scenarios.warning: Illustrative missing-access/egress allowance per affected linked transit journey, not data-imputed actual duration; zero allowance is observed elapsed, not zero true missing time.

matched_descriptive_checks.method: Exact shared cells of actual distance bins, activity purpose and origin CMS zone; at least 5 sampled journeys and 3 distinct diarists per mode per cell; standardize to pooled weighted distribution over those cells. Complete measured legs, positive elapsed <=240 minutes, no DOT duration/distance flag.

cautions: Trip-share denominator includes journeys whose true full duration is not observed; observed-minute shares are shares of captured minutes only, not shares of total travel time.
Complete-leg estimates select a different transit sample and must not be treated as a correction for missing time.
Durations include very large outliers. Uncapped estimates,0<duration<=240minute estimates and DOT-duration-flag-clear estimates are all supplied.
Trip distances are observed path distance, not straight-line or a common origin-destination distance. Matching remains descriptive and can select little overlap.
No replicate weights/design-based confidence intervals are produced; repeated journeys by each diarist are correlated.

Shared streets person-throughput and lane-conversion causal effects require corridor exposure, controls and before/after counts; these survey results establish resident travel mix and time context only.
Manhattan-origin estimates use citywide weights for a domain estimate of resident trips; they do not cover visitors or suburban inbound commuters.
DOT report headline uses start-and-end-within-NYC geography and broader mode groups; this analyst reconstruction is not represented as an exact replication.

official_headline_reconciliation.status: Not exactly reproduced; independent estimator, not official DOT headline.
official_headline_reconciliation.official_universe: Trips starting and ending in NYC
official_headline_reconciliation.independent_reconstruction_computation: Recomputed from the current raw inputs on every run; not a frozen audit result.
official_headline_reconciliation.reconstruction_recipe: Linked person+trip IDs; original-trip anchor citywide weights; complete anchor day in Trip and Day tables; first origin and last destination in_region=1; known-mode denominator; broader grouped modes. This is a separate diagnostic from the conservative baseline and includes consistent or inconsistent positive anchor weights.
official_headline_reconciliation.remaining_gap: Public report provides no exact recoding/filter recipe. Historical exploratory geography, weighting, completion and outlier variants did not resolve the discrepancy; those variant files are not recomputed by this script. No tuning to match headline.
